items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: So Sam took over the rest of the boys

ctx.x: We had breakfast and supper. So... Um, when did you actually give up playing? I mean, or more or less, we know...

Oh, when I stopped, uh, I stopped in just about to see... I shipped about... ...45. Something like that. When we were... When we were... When I stopped playing trombone, then, I went to playing piece and... ...played a little piece of violin, a small combo over there. Where was that? So Sam took over the rest of the boys to make the combination sound that would be head while I shipped to piece of violin. Oh, I see. I lived in Charlottesville, Virginia. Hmm. Went to the... Who were you playing with, uh, or did you…
